text:
sam: PSA: I'm prepping the quarterly access recert and an automated scan pulled ~12 admin-role principals without a recorded owner. list below + quick notes.

sam: ```
PRINCIPAL             ROLE        LAST_SEEN    NOTES
svc-cache-admin       admin       2025-12-11   likely old cache team svc
user:integration-bot  admin       2025-03-02   CI account, maybe deprecated
svc-pipeline-mgr      admin       2024-09-14   uses etl-key (see logs)
svc-dark-launch       admin       2023-05-21   sandbox/experiments
svc-metrics-ingest    admin       2025-10-02   emits to prod metrics
svc-legacy-auth       admin       2022-11-01   ancient service, offline?
svc-thirdparty-sync   admin       2025-01-30   external binding to partner project
svc-backup-rotator    admin       2025-07-08   backup job rotation
svc-canary-orch       admin       2025-11-02   used for canaries in staging
svc-hyperparam-sweep  admin       2024-08-13   ml experiments
svc-ssh-gateway       admin       2025-02-28   proxy for ssh helper
svc-db-migrator       admin       2025-06-05   migration tool
```

sam: scan command: `rbac-export --role admin --orphaned --since 2024-01-01 --output json`

vika: thanks. can you paste the KMS grant pairs for svc-pipeline-mgr and svc-db-migrator? i want to see key holders before we start outreach.

sam: quick audit snippet for svc-pipeline-mgr:

sam: ```
2025-11-02T03:22Z iam.grant KMS:decrypt principal=svc-pipeline-mgr key=projects/redwood/kms/keys/etl-key
2025-10-30T11:12Z auth.token_issued principal=svc-pipeline-mgr
2025-09-01T02:00Z iam.grant KMS:decrypt principal=svc-pipeline-mgr key=projects/partnerA/kms/keys/partner-key
```

jordy: that cross-project grant to partnerA is concerning. we should block-delete any external-binding before disabling locally, to avoid upstream failures. ops: can you verify whether partnerA is still active? @ops

ops: checking now. partnerA contact: partnerA-eng listed as active until 2025-06; will open ticket to ask for confirmation.

sec-bot: NOTE: upcoming recert window opens 2025-12-01T00:00Z. Auto-remediation policy will tag orphaned admins with `recert:pending` at T+3d.

vika: proposal: run owner-outreach + 5 business day SLA. If no owner responds, run staged disable in staging (48h canary) then rotate any affected KMS keys and remove admin role. We should document rollback by re-granting an emergency temp role with token TTL 1h.

sam: agreed. i'm going to create SEC-9876 "quarterly-recert: orphan-admins sweep" and add the list + audit exports. assigning initial outreach to @vika and @jordy.

jordy: draft outreach msg (for owners / infra contacts):

jordy: ```
Hi — we're doing our quarterly access recert. Our systems show the principal `svc-pipeline-mgr` has admin role but no owner on record and last activity on 2025-11-02. Please reply here or file a follow-up in SEC-9876 within 5 business days if this principal should remain. If we don't hear back we'll follow the staged disable process.
```

sam: nice. also adding an internal checklist in SEC-9876: `kms-grant-export`, `audit-log-correlation`, `staging-canary`, `key-rotation-plan`, `post-prune-audit`.

ops: posted partnerA verification ticket TKT-5521. will update SEC-9876 when partner responds.

vika: small ask — can infra also run `key-usage --principals svc-* --since 2024-01-01` and dump access patterns? we want to know if any of these principals decrypt production secrets frequently.

sam: queued. expect dump by tomorrow EOD.

jordy: action items:
- owner outreach @vika (5bd)
- staging canary disable for confirmed orphans @sam (48h smoke)
- KMS grant inventory + cross-project check @ops
- add principals to quarter recert board @jordy
- post-prune audit 7d after remediation @sec-bot

vik a: (typo) noted — will post updates in SEC-9876.

sec-bot: audit export ready: link to SEC-9876/artifacts/rbac-export-4301234567.json (sensitive).

sam: thanks — anyone object to accelerating svc-legacy-auth to immediate suspend? it's been unreferenced for >3y and last token 2022-11.

jordy: i'm +1. low risk. go for it and log the suspend in SEC-9876.

ops: suspended svc-legacy-auth at 2025-12-01T15:03Z  logged in TKT-5522. no alerts so far.

sam: good. will keep this thread updated with outreach responses.

sec-bot: reminder scheduled: recert follow-up in 3d for SEC-9876."
